summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including the integration of Hilbert curve clustering for improved data skipping and the addition of a variant type to the REST catalog specification. Ongoing discussions also focus on deprecating equality deletes in Iceberg V4 and the potential inclusion of incremental scan semantics in the table specification.
highlights: Hilbert curve ordering proposed for rewrite_data_files
Variant type to be added to REST catalog spec
Proposal to deprecate equality deletes in Iceberg V4
Discussion on incremental scan semantics for append scans
